claims.fact: Objectives: 1. To identify molecular subtypes of endometrial cancer using a combination of genomic and transcriptomic approaches.
claims.why: This states the first of the three project objectives and includes the exact objective content and methods.

claims.fact: Objectives: 2. To investigate the clinical and biological significance of the identified molecular subtypes, including their association with patient outcomes and response to therapy.
claims.why: This states the second of the three project objectives, including specifics about what significance to evaluate.

claims.fact: Objectives: 3. To develop biomarkers for the early detection and prognosis of endometrial cancer based on the identified molecular subtypes.
claims.why: This states the third of the three project objectives, including exact intended outputs (biomarkers) and endpoints (early detection and prognosis).
